meta.description: Registry for failure modes related to participation space measure refinement.

failure_modes.name: measure_collapse_into_continuation
failure_modes.description: Participation measure logic incorrectly depends on continuation actualization.

failure_modes.name: non_normalizable_measure
failure_modes.description: The declared measure cannot be normalized into a stable participation density.

failure_modes.name: measure_inconsistency_across_classes
failure_modes.description: Conflicting measure structures between different mechanism classes result in aliasing.

failure_modes.name: unbounded_measure_domain
failure_modes.description: The measure-theoretic domain lacks finite or sigma-finite bounds required for analysis.

failure_modes.name: boundary_measure_instability
failure_modes.description: Measure values fluctuate erratically near epsilon_null or window boundaries.
